subject: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)

Alex —

Thanks again for the deep demo yesterday. Based on our conversation about steady-state throughput and peak batch windows, I put together a concise option set for Dedicated (reserved commit) so we can align on pricing and activation logistics. Attached is a one‑page price matrix (redwood-dedicated-pricing-v3.pdf). Highlights below so you have the options in plain text: 

Summary (high level):
- 24‑month and 36‑month reserved commit tiers
- GPU pool sizing choices: 8x, 16x, 32x A100‑equivalent (configurable vCPU/RAM per GPU)
- Throughput SLOs expressed as average tokens/sec per pool + 95th‑pct latency targets for P95 token generation
- Ramp approach: slotted activation windows (described below) to avoid sudden capacity spikes

Representative pricing (illustrative):
- 24‑month: $0.60/token‑unit equivalent (baseline) with a 12% volume discount at >2x baseline usage
- 36‑month: $0.49/token‑unit equivalent with laddered discounts (see attachment)
- 12‑month (optional): premium of ~18% over 24‑month pricing for shorter commitment

Ramp / start mechanics (proposal):
- Soft start (months 0–3): 40% of committed capacity active; we provide staging credits to offset partial utilization
- Phase 2 (months 4–6): 70% active
- Full activation: month 7 onward for remainder of term
- If you need an accelerated ramp we can compress to 4 months with an activation fee to reserve burst slots

Flexibility asks / options we can include:
- Allowed start drift: up to 30 days post-signature without penalty; beyond that we provide a credit schedule (detailed in attachment)
- Early scale-ups: option to add GPUs midterm with pro‑rated pricing and a 60‑day notice
- Trial pool: 90‑day trial of up to 4 GPUs at reduced rate to validate perf/throughput before full activation (can be applied toward first tranche)

Next steps I suggest:
1) Quick sync (30m) to confirm pool size and target start quarter — can do Monday or Tuesday morning PT
2) If you’re good, I’ll send a versioned proposal (with DocuSign link) that includes the ramp credit table and an ops onboarding calendar

Appreciate the urgency on your side — happy to iterate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v3.pdf (1 page — pricing matrix)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orbitalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. A few clarifying items from procurement and engineering after reviewing: 

- Can you clarify the unit of measure you’ve used for "token‑unit equivalent" (we want to map to our QPS and avg token/response metrics)
- For the soft start credits: how are those applied on the invoice? We need predictable billing for our finance team
- Orbita's preferred start window could slip — we may not be ready to activate GPUs until late Q1. Any flexibility on start date without renegotiating the discount tiers?
- SOC 2 doc request: can you share the latest SOC 2 Type II report or a link to the relevant artifacts? Our security team needs these for the review packet

Also — on pricing: engineering asked whether you have a managed burst option for occasional high‑throughput jobs (10–12 hour bursts) and how that interacts with billing and the ramp schedule.

Would prefer a call early next week (Mon 10/05 10am PT) if that works for you and Marissa — we can pull procurement and cloud ops into the call.

Thanks,
Alex
CTO, Orbita Labs
alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com

----
Attachment: orbita-compliance-checklist.pdf (their checklist for vendor SOC 2 + encryption)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)

Alex / Ben —

Looping in Rishi as the deal lead for tiering and approval thresholds. A couple of concrete counterproposals that should address procurement and ops concerns: 

1) Measurement unit: we’ll map token‑units to your QPS by capturing an initial baseline (sample week) and publishing an expected tokens/week conversion. That mapping will be appended to the SOW so invoice clarity is explicit.

2) Billing credits during soft start: credits will appear as an invoice line item and are applied monthly until you hit the next tranche. We can cap invoice variability by converting credits to a fixed monthly rebate if that helps forecasting.

3) Start‑date flexibility: we can offer a 45‑day no‑penalty start window post‑signature. If activation is delayed beyond 45 days, a staged credit schedule applies (we can document exact percentages). This is smaller than the 90 days you asked for but avoids lock‑up of inventory.

4) Burst capacity: we offer a managed burst pool (16 GPUs) that can be scheduled in advance for up to 10 hours/day and billed on a per‑hour premium. Bursts during the soft start will be charged the burst rate and do not count toward baseline commit but can be converted to baseline if exercised >120 hours in a rolling 30‑day window.

5) Compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II redacted evidence + a short PCI/data flow diagram. I’ll drop links in the follow up.

Counter to 36‑month request: to get the deepest pricing anchor we need a 36‑month firm start expectation. That said, we can structure a laddered discount (5% at sign, additional 10% after month 12, and final 8% after month 24) so Orbita sees upside as you scale.

If that sounds reasonable we’ll prepare a tracked‑changes SOW with the 45‑day start window and the credit table.

—Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0210

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)

Marissa / Ben —

Appreciate the clarifications. Procurement pushed back on two items that would prevent us from moving forward immediately: 

1) Discount depth on the 36‑month. To commit at that term we need a minimum blended discount of 60% off your listed public unit price (they want the business case aligned to multi‑year savings).
2) Start‑date buffer. They need a 90‑day shift allowance without re‑pricing given our internal release calendar risk. A shorter 45‑day window is hard for them to accept.

Security is satisfied that Redwood can provide SOC 2 artifacts; they asked that the artifacts be available within 3 business days after LOI. We also need DocuSign iterations (signed LOI then SOW).

We’re sensitive to the staging/credit complexity — happy to accept the rebate approach on invoices if that’s the path of least resistance.

If Redwood can commit to the discount ladder and extend the no‑penalty start to 90 days (or provide additional credits that materially offset the start drift), we’ll be able to get internal approval to sign an LOI next week.

—Alex
CTO, Orbita Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slotted commit & ramp schedule — Orbita Labs (Dedicated capacity)

Alex —

Thanks — we want to get you to LOI next week as well. After a quick internal review with finance and product (Rishi looped), here's a compromise we can put on the table formally: 

1) Discount ladder (36‑month):
   - Signing credit: 10% off baseline
   - After month 12 (if committed volumes met): additional 10%
   - After month 24 (if volumes met): additional 8%
   -> Effective blended discount at target volumes ~26–28% (not 60%).

2) Start flexibility: we can extend the no‑penalty start window to 75 days. For any start beyond 75 days up to 180 days, we will apply a monthly staging credit equal to 8% of the committed monthly charge to offset the lock‑up. That credit is refundable/transferable to future invoices but not cash redeemable.

3) To address procurement concerns on the math we will:
   - Provide a clear tokens↔QPS conversion appendix in the SOW
   - Publish a sample invoice template showing the credit/rebate line

4) Compliance artifacts: we’ll share the SOC 2 Type II redacted report + a short ops runbook within 2 business days of LOI.

I attached the updated proposal (proposal-orbita-vfinal.pdf) and included links for the DocuSign envelope in the related links. If you can accept the 75‑day window + staged credits, Marissa will send LOI language tomorrow for signature and we’ll lock the pricing ladder in the SOW.

If not, we should take 30 minutes tomorrow to see where we can bridge the delta.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: proposal-orbita-vfinal.pdf (3 pages — SOW + credit table + onboarding calendar)
